camera.purpose: warehouse observation and downstream semantic inference input

electrical_model.integral: sum((positive wheel mechanical power / drive efficiency + auxiliary power) * dt / 3600)
electrical_model.parameter_provenance: fixture sensitivity design values; not measured or calibrated robot electrical characteristics

limitations: Wheel joint effort and speed are simulated dynamics outputs, not measured motor current.
The 60 percent drivetrain efficiency, 10 W auxiliary load, 24 Wh battery, and initial SOC are design assumptions.
Downhill regeneration receives no credit; negative wheel mechanical power is excluded from drive draw.
This trace supports modeled-energy accounting and SOC software integration only; it does not establish physical Wh accuracy or battery savings.
